auto_track_description: Let Monyvi read your financial SMS to automatically track your spending
feature_instant_description: Automatically detect transactions from your bank & wallet SMS
feature_secure_description: Only matching financial SMS from supported banks and wallets are sent securely to our AI provider for parsing. Message bodies are not stored after parsing and are not used for training.
feature_control_description: Review every transaction before it's saved. Decline any you don't want.
ai_consent_body: To use this feature, Monyvi sends the SMS or voice note securely to our AI provider so it can suggest transactions.
ai_sms_consent_body: Monyvi can read financial SMS messages and send matching messages securely to our AI provider to suggest transactions.
ai_sms_consent_sms_access_body: Used to find bank and wallet messages on this device.
ai_sms_consent_ai_processing_body: Used to parse matching messages into editable suggestions.
ai_consent_row_choose: Only when you choose SMS or voice
ai_sms_consent_settings_note: You can change this later in Settings.
ai_privacy_sms_payload: SMS import - matching financial SMS text, sender name, message date, and temporary message ID.
ai_privacy_voice_payload: Voice entry - your voice note, local date, account names, account IDs, currencies, and category list for matching.
ai_privacy_why_body: Our AI provider reads the message or voice note and suggests editable transactions. You review before saving, except when you turn on Live SMS auto-confirm.
ai_privacy_no_ads: No ads or selling your data.
ai_privacy_no_raw_sms_saved: No raw SMS saved to transaction or transfer records after review.
ai_privacy_provider_body: Short app screens say AI provider. This page names the provider: Google Gemini.
ai_privacy_footer: You can turn off AI features later in Settings.
